spanish: Y si de callar callare a ella su varón desde día a día, y levantó todos sus votos o todas sus ataduras que sobre ella, los levantó, porque calló a ella en día de su oír.

findings.issue: Hiphil sequential perfect after the conditional imperfect continues that non-past condition; preterite «levantó» places the establishing in the past, like the later plain perfect.

notes: Silence toward her, her man, from day to day, all her vows or all her bonds upon her, and his hearing on that day match the tokens.
